sources.title: Standard Solar Boosts California’s Clean Energy With 25 MW Solar Project Acquisition

name: Wrexham Solar Park
description: A 15 MWp solar park near Wrexham, Wales, owned by Atrato Onsite Energy, supplying Dŵr Cymru Welsh Water by private wire.

sources.title: Innova and Atrato Onsite Energy Reach Financial Close on 15MWp Wrexham Solar Park

name: Xekong 4A and 4B Hydro
description: 355 MW of hydropower in Laos developed by RATCH Group's Xekong 4 Power, selling to Thailand's EGAT under a PPA signed in December 2023.

sources.title: RATCH Group subsidiary completes hydropower investment

name: Yanco Delta Wind Farm
description: A 1.5 GW wind farm with an 800 MWh battery on 33,000 ha in the South West Renewable Energy Zone, New South Wales, bought by Origin Energy.

sources.title: Origin Energy expands RE portfolio with Yanco Delta Wind Farm acquisition

name: Yarnton BESS
description: A 49.9 MW battery at Yarnton, Oxfordshire, developed by Renewable Connections and owned by Schroders Greencoat's Wessex Gardens fund. Construction starts in 2027.

sources.title: Rivington Energy sells Oxfordshire BESS

name: Zaragoza Wind-Solar Cluster
description: A 199 MW cluster of three wind farms and two solar plants sharing a grid connection near Zaragoza, built by BayWa r.e. and sold to Encavis.

sources.title: BayWa r.e. sells Spanish 199 MW wind and solar project to Encavis AG

name: ZE-BRA Wind Farm
description: A repowered wind farm of 15 new turbines on the Zeeland–Noord-Brabant border, replacing 19 older ones, owned by Eneco, Lindewind and Zeeuwind.

sources.title: Eneco secures financing for ZE-BRA wind farm
